steps.command: F=/tmp/mirage-job-$RANDOM$RANDOM; python3 -c 'import signal, sys, time; signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_: sys.exit(3)); open(sys.argv[1], "w").close(); time.sleep(60)' "$F" & i=0; until perl -e 'exit !-e $ARGV[0]' "$F" || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; kill %1; wait %1; echo $?; perl -e 'unlink @ARGV' "$F" "$F.done"

F=/tmp/mirage-job-$RANDOM$RANDOM; python3 -c 'import signal, sys, time; signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_: (time.sleep(0.3), open(sys.argv[1] + ".done", "w").close(), sys.exit(0))); open(sys.argv[1], "w").close(); time.sleep(60)' "$F" & i=0; until perl -e 'exit !-e $ARGV[0]' "$F" || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; kill %1; wait %1; echo $?; perl -e 'print -e $ARGV[0] ? qq(saved\n) : qq(missing\n)' "$F.done"; perl -e 'unlink @ARGV' "$F" "$F.done"

steps.command: python3 -c 'import os; os.kill(os.getpid(), 9)' & wait %1; echo $?

F=/tmp/mirage-job-$RANDOM$RANDOM; python3 -c 'import os, sys, time; open(sys.argv[1], "w").close(); any(os.path.exists(sys.argv[1] + ".go") or time.sleep(0.05) for _ in range(600))' "$F" & i=0; until perl -e 'exit !-e $ARGV[0]' "$F" || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; echo "[$(ps -o ppid=,comm= | awk -v j=$! '$1 == j { print $2 }')]"; perl -e 'open my $f, ">", $ARGV[0]' "$F.go"; wait; perl -e 'unlink @ARGV' "$F" "$F.go"
